```{r setup, include=FALSE}
fmt_eu_coord <- function (x) {
  s <- format(round(as.numeric(x), 2L), nsmall = 2L, trim = TRUE)
  gsub("\\.", ",", s)
}

interp_site_pop <- function (e, yr_num) {
  ps <- e$population
  if (is.null(ps) || length(ps) == 0L) return(NA_real_)
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(ps))
  vals <- as.numeric(unlist(ps))
  ord <- order(yrs)
  yrs <- yrs[ord]
  vals <- vals[ord]
  if (yr_num < yrs[1] || yr_num > yrs[length(yrs)]) return(NA_real_)
  idx <- which(yrs == yr_num)
  if (length(idx) > 0L) return(vals[idx[1]])
  stats::approx(x = yrs, y = vals, xout = yr_num, method = "linear")$y
}

fmt_site_pop <- function (e, yr_num) {
  p <- interp_site_pop(e, yr_num)
  if (is.na(p) || p <= 0) return("-")
  viscount_fmt_pop(p)
}

fmt_site_peak <- function (e) {
  ps <- e$population
  if (is.null(ps) || length(ps) == 0L) return("-")
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(ps))
  vals <- as.numeric(unlist(ps))
  i_pk <- which.max(vals)
  paste0(viscount_fmt_pop(vals[i_pk]), " (", yrs[i_pk], "AD)")
}

  "imperial_ethiopia_north_central",
  "imperial_ethiopia_south_west",
  "imperial_ethiopia_hararghe_ogaden",
  "italian_eritrea",

sub_by_id <- setNames(summary_cache$subregions, vapply(summary_cache$subregions, function (x) x$id, character(1)))

entry_sub_ids <- vapply(all_entries, function (e) {
  s <- subregion_lookup[[e$key]]
  if (is.null(s)) "imperial_ethiopia_north_central" else s
}, character(1))

zone_entries <- setNames(lapply(subregion_order, function (sid) {
  sub <- all_entries[entry_sub_ids == sid]
  pks <- vapply(sub, function (e) max(as.numeric(unlist(e$population))), numeric(1))
  sub[order(-pks, vapply(sub, function (e) e$name, character(1)))]
}), subregion_order)

build_gazetteer_df <- function (sub_list) {
  rows <- lapply(sub_list, function (e) {
    iso_code <- iso3_map[[as.character(e$country)]]
    if (is.null(iso_code)) iso_code <- toupper(substr(as.character(e$country), 1L, 3L))
    loc_str <- paste0(iso_code, ": ", fmt_eu_coord(e$coords[[1]]), ", ", fmt_eu_coord(e$coords[[2]]))
    data.frame(
      Settlement = as.character(e$name),
      Location = loc_str,
      `1880AD` = fmt_site_pop(e, 1880),
      `1910AD` = fmt_site_pop(e, 1910),
      `1930AD` = fmt_site_pop(e, 1930),
      `1950AD` = fmt_site_pop(e, 1950),
      `1960AD` = fmt_site_pop(e, 1960),
      Peak = fmt_site_peak(e),
      check.names = FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  df <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  rownames(df) <- NULL
  df
}

n_excluded <- as.integer(summary_cache$wave_saturation_stats$ledger_excluded)
n_candidates <- length(all_entries) + n_excluded
bench_nums <- c(1880, 1910, 1930, 1950, 1956, 1960)
bench_keys <- as.character(bench_nums)
n_active <- setNames(
  vapply(bench_nums, function (yr) sum(vapply(all_entries, function (e) !is.na(interp_site_pop(e, yr)), logical(1))), integer(1)),
  bench_keys
)
```

# Abstract

This gazetteer compiles coordinates and multi-date population series for `r viscount_fmt_number(length(all_entries), 0L)` individually assessed settlements across eleven modern jurisdictions in the Horn of Africa and Anglo-Egyptian Sudan between 1880AD and 1960AD. Screened from `r viscount_fmt_number(n_candidates, 0L)` candidate towns, railway stations, colonial administrative posts and historic ports (`r viscount_fmt_number(n_excluded, 0L)` duplicate aliases excluded), the retained entries span nine sub-regions across Imperial Ethiopia, Italian Eritrea, French and British Somaliland, Italian Somaliland and the nine Condominium provinces of Sudan. Active interpolated records expand from `r viscount_fmt_number(n_active[["1880"]], 0L)` settlements in 1880AD to `r viscount_fmt_number(n_active[["1910"]], 0L)` in 1910AD, `r viscount_fmt_number(n_active[["1930"]], 0L)` in 1930AD and `r viscount_fmt_number(n_active[["1950"]], 0L)` in 1950AD, led by Addis Ababa (541,7k agglomeration, 444k city proper), Khartoum (342,7k agglomeration), Omdurman (148k), Asmara (123,5k) and Mogadishu (101,5k).

```{r fig1-md-only, results='asis'}
if (!knitr::is_latex_output()) {
  viscount_figure(
    "figures/fig_01_map.png",
    "Spatial distribution of 239 individually assessed settlements across nine colonial and imperial sub-regions in the Horn of Africa and Anglo-Egyptian Sudan (1880AD to 1960AD).",
    "fig:hero-settlements-horn"
  )
}
```

# Background

Compiling an urban and small-town ledger across Northeast Africa between 1880AD and 1960AD requires integrating divergent archival traditions. Imperial Ethiopia lacked national censuses prior to 1984AD, leaving Addis Ababa, Harar, Dire Dawa, Gonder and Dese documented through traveller counts, Italian occupation municipal surveys and post-war statistical tallies [@Pankhurst1968EconomicHistory; @ARCCH2020EthiopiaInventory]. By contrast, Italian Eritrea produced systematic enumerations from 1905AD to 1939AD [@Fuller2011ItalyColonial], British and Italian Somalilands relied on port Blue Books and protectorate returns [@Omar2001ScrambleHorn; @Kuczynski1949DemographicSurvey2], and Anglo-Egyptian Sudan transitioned from early Condominium tax rolls to the 1955-1956 First Population Census [@Division1922HandbookThe; @Sudan1956Census].

# Methodology

## Candidate Screening and Sub-Regional Assignment

Of `r viscount_fmt_number(n_candidates, 0L)` candidate entries inside the `r viscount_fmt_number(summary_cache$total_area_km2, 0L)` km² study domain bounded over geoBoundaries national outlines [@Runfola2020GeoBoundaries], `r viscount_fmt_number(n_excluded, 0L)` duplicate transliteration aliases were removed, retaining `r viscount_fmt_number(length(all_entries), 0L)` individually assessed settlements across `r viscount_fmt_number(summary_cache$observation_count, 0L)` chronological observations. Each entry is assigned to one of the nine colonial or imperial sub-regions (237 inside the 5-arcminute interior raster plus Birao and Faza reconciled on the western Darfur and southern Somali margins).

## Scope Conventions and Linear Interpolation

The ledger distinguishes 232 city-proper municipal records from 7 post-1950 metropolitan agglomerations (Addis Ababa, Khartoum, Asmara, Mogadishu, Hargeisa, Djibouti and Juba) [@Demisse2024UrbanLand; @Darwich2025PortInfrastructures]. Tables 1 to 9 report linearly interpolated headcounts at five benchmarks (1880AD, 1910AD, 1930AD, 1950AD and 1960AD) alongside each entry's peak population and date, marking benchmarks outside an entry's observed span with a hyphen (-).

# Testing and Validation

Across all `r viscount_fmt_number(length(all_entries), 0L)` retained settlements, upper-half Zipf regression (119 entries) yields $q = 1,07$ ($R^2 = 0,99$) and full-sample regression yields $q = 1,21$ ($R^2 = 0,96$), aligning closely with the 230 spatially deduplicated settlement peaks displayed in Figure \ref{fig:settlements-rank} ($q = 0,98$, $R^2 = 0,99$).

```{r fig3-ranksize, results='asis'}
viscount_figure(
  "figures/fig_03_rank_size.png",
  "Zipf rank-size curve across 230 spatially deduplicated settlements (q = 0,98, R² = 0,99) and mean sub-regional density in 1960AD.",
  "fig:settlements-rank",
  arg3_options = list(max_height = "0.38\\textheight")
)
```

# Limitations

Three constraints bound this settlement gazetteer. First, 28 of the 239 records carry single-date observations, producing hyphens outside their observed date. Second, seven capitals pair metropolitan agglomerations (1950AD to 1960AD) with municipal cores, while two towns (Wad Madanī alongside Wad Medani, and Harar alongside Harare) preserve distinct source series that should not be summed as independent cities. Third, combined settlement counts reflect attested towns and administrative stations rather than full rural populations reported in the companion review.

# Conclusion

Together, these `r viscount_fmt_number(length(all_entries), 0L)` individually assessed settlements trace the transformation of Northeast Africa's urban system from Mahdist Omdurman and late nineteenth-century caravan centres to the railway, irrigated and metropolitan capitals of 1960AD.

# Appendix

## Sub-Regional Gazetteer Summary

Table \ref{tab:gazetteer-summary} sums site counts and combined interpolated settlement populations across all nine sub-regions at the six chapter benchmarks from 1880AD to 1960AD.

```{r tab-appendix-summary, results='asis'}
sum_rows <- lapply(subregion_order, function (sid) {
  sub <- zone_entries[[sid]]
  sums <- setNames(vapply(bench_nums, function (yr) {
    vals <- vapply(sub, function (e) {
      p <- interp_site_pop(e, yr)
      if (is.na(p) || p <= 0) 0 else p
    }, numeric(1))
    viscount_fmt_pop(sum(vals))
  }, character(1)), bench_keys)
  data.frame(
    `Subregion (Sites)` = paste0(sub_by_id[[sid]]$name, " (", viscount_fmt_number(length(sub), 0L), ")"),
    `1880AD` = sums[["1880"]],
    `1910AD` = sums[["1910"]],
    `1930AD` = sums[["1930"]],
    `1950AD` = sums[["1950"]],
    `1956AD` = sums[["1956"]],
    `1960AD` = sums[["1960"]],
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})
tot_sums <- setNames(vapply(bench_nums, function (yr) {
  vals <- vapply(all_entries, function (e) {
    p <- interp_site_pop(e, yr)
    if (is.na(p) || p <= 0) 0 else p
  }, numeric(1))
  viscount_fmt_pop(sum(vals))
}, character(1)), bench_keys)
tot_row <- data.frame(
  `Subregion (Sites)` = paste0("All Subregions (", viscount_fmt_number(length(all_entries), 0L), ")"),
  `1880AD` = tot_sums[["1880"]],
  `1910AD` = tot_sums[["1910"]],
  `1930AD` = tot_sums[["1930"]],
  `1950AD` = tot_sums[["1950"]],
  `1956AD` = tot_sums[["1956"]],
  `1960AD` = tot_sums[["1960"]],
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
df_sum <- rbind(do.call(rbind, sum_rows), tot_row)
rownames(df_sum) <- NULL
viscount_table(
  df_sum,
  "Individually assessed site counts and combined interpolated populations across nine sub-regions (1880AD to 1960AD).",
  arg3_options = list(label = "tab:gazetteer-summary")
)
```
